children: U.S. public safety tech provider's Q4 net sales fell 12% yr/yr to $66.2 mln
Company posted Q4 operating loss from continuing operations of $3.9 mln
Comtech agreed to sell most of its Satellite and Space business for $157.5 mln cash
Company expects to close sale of most S&S business in calendar 2026
Comtech anticipates investing $13 mln to $15 mln in transition costs over fiscal 2027-2028
Company expects annual cost savings of $16 mln to $18 mln after S&S sale and transition
GROSS MARGIN EXPANSION - Co attributed higher gross margin to continued adoption of its solutions and migration of PSAPs onto NG9-1-1 core services and call handling platforms
PRODUCT LAUNCHES - Co launched Allerium Mira and Allerium Coral in June, aimed at expanding capabilities for public safety agencies
CYBERSECURITY TRAINING - Higher net sales of cyber security training services partly offset declines in location-based and call handling solutions
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the communications & networking peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Comtech Telecommunications Corp is $4.25, about 226.9% above its October 13 closing price of $1.30
